$comment: Revision targets for the LCLite overlay. `primary` is where mods are AUTHORED — the tree you edit and run regen against; its corpus lives in mods/<mod>/patches/<primary>/ and every other revision is ported FROM it. `supported` lists every revision the overlay may be installed onto, and `doctor` fails when this declaration and the corpora on disk disagree. A revision with `inherits` uses that revision's corpus unchanged: it costs nothing to maintain and automatically follows improvements to the primary one, which is only allowed while every anchor still matches byte-for-byte there — `node tools/matrix.mjs` re-verifies that against real clones. A revision whose upstream code moved inside an anchor gets its own corpus under mods/<mod>/patches/<rev>/ (generated by `node tools/port.mjs <rev>` + regen) and stops inheriting.

289.note: the revision LCLite is developed on — the launcher's recommended one

274.note: every anchor in the 289 corpus still matches 274 byte-for-byte, so it needs no corpus of its own (matrix verifies this)

254.note: own corpus: upstream rewrote code inside 41 of the 104 anchors the corpus had at the last port. 6 mods are ported (tcg needed two hand-fixed 254-specific call sites); control-panel, camera, xp-drops, stat-orbs and hotkeys hook code that does not exist at 254 yet, and the legacy-telemetry suppression lives in camera now, so 254 has none — see docs/REVS.md
